title: VISTA：离散扩散模型序列蒙特卡洛引导的价值感知调度裁剪加速方法
summary: VISTA 是一种免训练方法，通过价值统计与动态规划自动选择稀疏引导时间步，在固定预算下逼近全引导概率路径，显著加速奖励引导的离散扩散生成。在文本、生物序列和图像任务中，它发现任务相关调度，多数场景优于手工稀疏调度，毒性文本生成实现 5.35 倍加速。
summary_en: VISTA is a training-free method that automatically selects sparse guidance timesteps under a fixed budget by formulating sparse guidance as approximation of the ideal full-guidance probability path and optimizing an empirical surrogate via dynamic programming using value statistics from warmup generations. Across text, biological sequence, and image tasks, it discovers task-dependent schedules, outperforming hand-designed sparse schedules and achieving a 5.35x speedup on toxic-text generation.
